final_response_fingerprint.content: Extract Google and GitHub OAuth sites

final_response_fingerprint.title: Deduplicate OAuth sites
final_response_fingerprint.user_intention: Use agent-desktop and 1Password CLI to identify sites where the user has signed in using Google/Gmail or GitHub, then return a deduplicated list.

final_response_fingerprint.feedback_loop: Captured the exact 110 children of Google’s Sign in with Google results group; counted 110 rows, 106 unique labels, and four duplicate labels (Eventbrite, Fantastical, Notion, workos.com). Separately captured Google Other account access (12 names). GitHub Authorized OAuth Apps pages 1, 2, and 3 were validated with distinct app markers and shown to total 37 grants. Provider association limits remain: GitHub grants do not prove which grants were created by Sign in with GitHub, and the Google other-access category is separate.
final_response_fingerprint.stopping_evidence: Concrete provider pages now fully expose Google sign-in rows and all GitHub OAuth grants. Deduplication can be done by exact app labels, but the two provider systems do not disclose cross-provider login provenance for each GitHub OAuth grant.
